Market: BTC 15m/4h scanners both SHORT_BIAS and market_phase DECLINING, but BTC just reclaimed EMA300 (was below 696 min, now AT 81478 vs EMA 81415) with STRONG_POS zscore and short-term slopes up. This is a declining larger phase with an active bounce — the worst environment for both blanket longs and blanket shorts, and it explains the last 48h of losses on both sides (LONG -0.90/45 trades, SHORT -0.50/17 trades).

Verified loss anatomy (PostgreSQL, 48h): exits that never arm the trail are the bleed — atr_sl_hit 19 trades 1W -1.69, hard_max_loss 8 trades 0W -0.96, trail_arm_timeout 4 trades 0W -0.30. Exits that ride trails are the harvest — profit-monster-trail 13/14W +0.54, atr_trail_hit 6/7W +1.13. Every recent loss is a trade that entered during chop/bounce and died before the trend family could take over.

Wrong-side cases: doji-bottom-long bought deep-oversold knives (meta_rsi <40: ZEN 29.5, CRV 39.8, WCT 27.8 — 0W/5L in 7d) while its wins all came from mid-band entries (40-56) that trailed. pump-chain- SHORT shorted mid-band pumps (meta_rsi 42-56) and went 0W/8L — the winning side on those same moves was LONG (pump-chain+ LONG +0.36/48h with trail wins). We keep picking the side that the other participant fades.

APT LONG fill at meta_rsi 33.7 (pick was 57.1) = hard_max_loss -4.2%. Drift guard (rsi_at_pick) now in place because of this exact trade.

Bottom line: we are not unlucky — we are entering on the wrong side of chop and calling it signal noise. Trend entries (trail family) still print; chop entries (SL family) still bleed. Nothing to close right now (flat book), so the action is on entry quality, not position management.

1) doji-bottom-long deep-oversold knife catch — n=5 entries at meta_rsi<40 in 7d (ZEN 29.5, CRV 39.8, WCT 27.8, plus BANANA 13.3, ME 4.0 from 10-13): 0W/5L, all atr_sl/hard_max/stale exits. Same signal at meta_rsi 40-56: GMT/DOGE/ONDO/XPL/WLFI all profit-monster-trail wins. All-time n=36, 19W, +0.04 total. WINNING side: not buying a falling knife — the dump continued; either stay out or short the breakdown. Mid-band reclaim longs work; deep oversold longs are the wrong side in a DECLINING phase.

2) pump-chain- SHORT mid-band — n=8 in 48h, 0W, -0.49 USDT. Entry meta_rsi 42-56 (FIL 42.2, DOT 43.5/55.6, INJ 52.9, GRASS 43.6, CRV 48.2, IO 48.5, APT 47.3); 7/8 atr_sl_hit = the pump continued and stopped us out. WINNING side: LONG those same pumps — pump-chain+ LONG made +0.36 on 7 trades in the same window with the big trail winners. We shorted the momentum; the long side got paid.

3) Trail vs chop exit split — 48h: trail exits 21 trades, 19W, +1.67 combined; SL/max-loss exits 32 trades, 1W, -3.04 combined. Confirms house edge lives entirely in trades that reach +0.40% and arm the trail; every loser family is chop entries that never get there.
